battle.name: 波烏戰爭
battle.brief: 波烏戰爭於1918年11月在東加利西亞爆發，波蘭軍與西烏克蘭人民共和國軍為爭奪當地控制權交戰，戰線延伸至利沃夫周邊。線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun）是德軍於1850年列裝的正式型號，屬野戰砲兵，負責在陸戰中支援步兵作戰，並為地面部隊提供火力支援。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛砲自1850年起納入德國陸軍野戰砲兵序列，屬於地面火力體系的支援武器，主要配合步兵部隊作戰，並參與前線砲兵部署。

countries: 交戰主體是第二波蘭共和國與西烏克蘭人民共和國；嚴格說，一九一八年十一月開戰時，烏克蘭方面仍以烏克蘭軍事委員會及加利西亞軍名義行動，直到十一月中旬西烏克蘭人民共和國成立後才承擔國家層級的政治責任。波蘭方面則由波蘭軍事組織、波蘭東線軍與臨時政府逐步交接指揮。戰區涵蓋原奧匈帝國的加利西亞與沃里西亞；布列斯特是通往波蘭本土的補給樞紐，利沃夫斯克、普熱米希爾、捷爾諾皮爾、科韋利與別列扎尼則是鐵路、兵站及軍械庫的爭奪中心。
countriesEn: The principal belligerents were the Second Polish Republic and the West Ukrainian People's Republic. Strictly speaking, when the war began in November 1918, the Ukrainian side was still operating under the Ukrainian Military Committee and the Galician Army, and only assumed state-level political responsibility after the West Ukrainian People's Republic was established in mid-November. On the Polish side, command passed gradually from the Polish Military Organization through the Polish Eastern Army to the provisional government. The theatre covered Galicia and Volhynia, formerly part of Austria-Hungary. Brest was the supply hub leading toward Poland proper, while Lviv, Przemyśl, Ternopil, Kowel, and Berezhany were the principal contested railway stations, military depots, and arsenals.
people: 初期最有影響的指揮者來自兩套軍事機構。烏克蘭軍事委員會由季米特里·維托夫斯基主持，他率領突擊小隊控制利沃夫斯克；米耶奇斯瓦夫·博魯塔－斯皮耶霍維奇則代表波蘭軍事組織組織城內守軍。葉夫亨·佩特留拉其後整合西烏克蘭人民軍並擔任最高軍事負責人；米哈伊洛·奧梅利亞諾維奇－帕夫連科率領北方集群深入沃里西亞。波蘭方面，瓦迪斯瓦夫·西科爾斯基在十一月中旬整編東線部隊並發動普熱米希爾反擊，瓦迪斯瓦夫·安德斯以第一旅在拉拉尼奇取勝。約瑟夫·哈勒主持藍軍整編並補充東線兵力；愛德華·雷茲－希米格爾於一九一九年春接掌波蘭第一軍，負責最後階段的攻勢。
peopleEn: The commanders who shaped the opening phase came from two separate military organizations. The Ukrainian Military Committee was led by Dmytro Vitovsky, who directed the assault detachments that seized control of Lviv, while Mieczysław Boruta-Spiechowicz represented the Polish Military Organization and organized the city garrison. Yevhen Petliura subsequently integrated the West Ukrainian People's Republic's army and served as its senior military authority; Mykhailo Omelianovych-Pavlenko led the Northern Group deep into Volhynia. On the Polish side, Władysław Sikorski reorganized the eastern forces in mid-November and launched the counterattack at Przemyśl, while Władysław Anders won at Rarańcz with the 1st Brigade. Józef Haller supervised the reorganization of the Blue Army and the reinforcement of the eastern front, and Edward Rydz-Śmigły assumed command of the Polish 1st Army in the spring of 1919 to direct the final offensive.
kits: 前線裝備呈現帝國軍械與新國家軍械混用的局面。波蘭軍可使用五點九乘二十三公釐 Gewehr 88、七點六三乘五十四公釐 Mauser Model 1888/90、八乘三十二公釐 Lebel Model 1886，以及從奧匈倉庫接收的八乘五十七公釐 Mannlicher Model 1888/90；火炮包括七十五公釐 wz. 1897 野戰炮。烏克蘭加利西亞軍與西烏克蘭人民軍配用七點六二乘五十四公釐 Mosin-Nagant Model 1891、原奧匈 Mannlicher Model 1888/90、七點六三乘五十四公釐 Schwarzlose Model 1907/12 機槍，並使用七點五公分 M15 野戰炮及十點五公分 M.16 榴彈炮。這些型號在一九一八年以前均已列裝，但步槍與炮彈口徑並未統一，同一座兵站內可能同時存放數種彈藥，前線因而必須按軍械來源配發彈藥、維修零件與馬匹載具。
kitsEn: The front's equipment combined imperial weapons with those of the emerging states. Polish forces could use the 5.9×23mm Gewehr 88, 7.63×54mm Mauser Model 1888/90, 8×32mmR Lebel Model 1886, and captured 8×57mm Mannlicher Model 1888/90 rifles, together with the 75mm wz. 1897 field gun. The Ukrainian Galician Army and the West Ukrainian People's Republic used the 7.62×54mmR Mosin-Nagant Model 1891, the former Austro-Hungarian Mannlicher Model 1888/90, and the 7.63×54mmR Schwarzlose Model 1907/12 machine gun, as well as the 7.5cm M15 field gun and 10.5cm M.16 howitzer. All of these models had entered service before 1918, but rifle and artillery calibers were not standardized. Several kinds of ammunition could therefore be stored in the same depot, and ammunition, spare parts, and horse-drawn transport had to be distributed according to the origin of each unit's equipment.
tactics: 十一月一日，烏克蘭軍以小隊同時控制車站、機關、兵站與軍械庫，利用突然取得的位置把分散的守住轉成據點防守；西烏克蘭突擊部隊再以連續小組攻擊外圍道路。利沃夫斯克波蘭守軍依賴城內陣地逐段抵抗，未能立即奪回外圍控制權。西科爾斯基則把鐵路速度轉成反擊速度，沿普熱米希爾與波蘭本土之間的補給線集中旅級部隊，再以連續攻擊切斷烏克蘭對利沃夫斯克外圍的供應。十二月底拉拉尼奇戰鬥中，安德斯集中第一旅攻擊兩翼，砲兵先壓制道路與陣地，步兵隨後突破，守軍退向別列扎尼方向。冬季兩軍沿鐵路和主要公路反覆奪取橋頭、渡口及高地，騎兵負責偵察與側翼警戒。三月以後波蘭投入較完整的師級兵力；希魯夫戰敗迫使烏克蘭軍反攻並一度重奪博列希夫，但波蘭於六月再取該地。七月茲博里夫戰鬥中，波蘭第一軍以炮兵壓制縱深，步兵沿多條道路同時推進，騎兵遮蔽翼側，決定性突破迫使烏克蘭軍退出整條戰線。
tacticsEn: On 1 November, Ukrainian detachments simultaneously occupied railway stations, government offices, depots, and arsenals, converting a surprise seizure into a chain of defended points; West Ukrainian assault troops then attacked the roads leading into the city with successive small groups. The Polish garrison at Lviv resisted sector by sector from established positions and could not immediately recover the outer approaches. Sikorski, by contrast, converted railway speed into counterattack speed, concentrating brigade-sized units along the supply route between Przemyśl and Poland proper and then cutting Ukrainian support to the outskirts of Lviv through consecutive attacks. In the Battle of Rarańcz at the end of December, Anders concentrated the 1st Brigade against both flanks, used artillery to suppress roads and positions before the infantry assault broke through, and drove the defenders toward Berezhany. During the winter, both sides repeatedly contested bridges, river crossings, and heights along the railways and main roads, with cavalry conducting reconnaissance and guarding the flanks. From March, Poland committed more complete division-sized formations. The Ukrainian victory at Chyrów forced a counteroffensive that temporarily recovered Bolekhiv, but Poland retook the town in June. At Zboriv in July, the Polish 1st Army used artillery to suppress depth, advanced infantry along several roads at once, and covered its flanks with cavalry; the decisive penetration forced the Ukrainian formations out of the entire sector.
data: 此戰通常斷代為一九一八年十一月一日至一九一九年七月二十八日。十月二十一日夜至十月三十一日夜間，烏克蘭軍事委員會成立並為接管利沃夫斯克作準備；十一月一日，維托夫斯基所部控制城內關鍵設施，波蘭軍事組織守軍退入城區。十一月三日至五日，莫克羅圖夫與普斯圖尼一線的戰鬥阻止烏克蘭軍迅速突破。十一月十二日，西科爾斯基所部奪回普熱米希爾，打開通往波蘭本土的鐵路；十一月二十一日，利沃夫斯克守軍在增援無法突破封鎖後投降。十一月二十一日至二十三日，烏克蘭北方集群攻取科韋利，把戰線向北伸展。十二月二十七日至三十日，安德斯第一旅在拉拉尼奇取勝，波軍隨後控制別列扎尼及通往捷爾諾皮爾的交通線。一九一九年一月至二月，兩軍在利沃夫斯克以東、赫魯別舒夫周邊及沃里西亞鐵路沿線爭奪據點。四月二十六日至二十七日，希魯夫戰鬥由西烏克蘭軍取勝；五月二十一日至二十四日，烏克蘭軍反攻並重奪博列希夫；六月十日至十三日，波軍再度攻下博列希夫。七月十八日至十九日，茲博里夫戰鬥形成決定性波蘭勝利，七月二十八日華沙停戰與初步劃界協議使戰鬥正式停止。各方檔案分別記錄戰死、病亡、失聯與被俘，統計基準並不一致，因此沒有可以可靠採用的單一總傷亡數字。
dataEn: The war is conventionally dated from 1 November 1918 to 28 July 1919. On the night of 21 October, the Ukrainian Military Committee was formally established and prepared to take Lviv; on 1 November, Vitovsky's troops seized the key installations while the Polish Military Organization garrison withdrew into the city. Fighting at Mokrotów and Pustyny from 3 to 5 November prevented the Ukrainians from breaking through rapidly. On 12 November, Sikorski's troops retook Przemyśl and reopened the railway toward Poland proper. On 21 November, the Lviv garrison surrendered after relief forces failed to break through. From 21 to 23 November, the Ukrainian Northern Group captured Kowel and extended the front northward. Between 27 and 30 December, Anders's 1st Brigade won at Rarańcz, after which the Polish forces secured Berezhany and the route toward Ternopil. In January and February 1919, both sides contested positions east of Lviv, around Hrubieszów, and along the Volhynian railways. The West Ukrainian forces won at Chyrów on 26 and 27 April; a counteroffensive from 21 to 24 May recovered Bolekhiv, which Polish forces captured again from 10 to 13 June. The Battle of Zboriv on 18 and 19 July produced a decisive Polish victory, and the Warsaw ceasefire and preliminary demarcation agreement of 28 July formally stopped the fighting. Polish and Ukrainian records classify deaths from combat, illness, missing personnel, and capture differently, so there is no single reliable total for all casualties.
cause: 戰爭的直接背景是一九一八年秋季原奧匈帝國軍政機關迅速瓦解，東加利西亞的行政權、鐵路管理權與武器分配權一度沒有明確承擔者。波蘭民族委員會與軍事組織以重建前波蘭王國的國家框架為基礎，要求接管加利西亞的軍政機關；烏克蘭軍事委員會則以東加利西亞的區域治理為基礎，著手建立自己的國家軍隊。雙方都掌握由前線返國的軍人、原奧匈官兵及分散的軍械庫，而利沃夫斯克的行政樞紐、普熱米希爾的鐵路和科韋利的北向交通使控制這些節點成為軍事問題。十月三十一日至十一月一日的爭奪因此不是單一衝突，而是兩套建國機構同時接管軍權、鐵路與補給系統的結果。
causeEn: The immediate background was the rapid collapse of the Austro-Hungarian military and administrative structure in autumn 1918. In East Galicia, authority over administration, railways, and the distribution of weapons temporarily had no clear custodian. The Polish National Council and Military Organization, building on the state framework of the former Polish Kingdom, sought control of Galician military and administrative institutions. The Ukrainian Military Committee, acting on a regional basis for East Galicia, began constructing its own national armed forces. Both sides had returning servicemen, former Austro-Hungarian troops, and access to dispersed arsenals, while Lviv's administrative position, Przemyśl's railway, and Kowel's northward communications made control of those nodes a military necessity. The struggle from 31 October to 1 November was therefore not an isolated dispute but the result of two state-building organizations simultaneously attempting to take over military authority, railways, and supply systems.
impact: 戰爭首先改變了東線的地理控制。波蘭取得利沃夫斯克、普熱米希爾、捷爾諾皮爾、別列扎尼及大部分沃里西亞交通線後，獲得較完整的鐵路補給網、原奧匈軍械庫與可繼續作戰的東線部隊；烏克蘭軍則失去西部鐵路樞紐和大量重裝備，卻仍保有完整的師旅體系，撤退後繼續在東加利西亞與蘇維埃軍隊作戰。對波蘭而言，這場戰役使原本分散的軍事組織獲得作戰經驗，並鞏固第二共和國的東部邊界；對烏克蘭而言，失敗暴露了兵站、彈藥口徑與後備兵力不足的問題。戰後邊界並未立即永久固定，波蘭與烏克蘭蘇維埃社會主義共和國直到一九二一年三月十八日簽署里加條約，才正式劃定國界。
impactEn: The war first transformed control of the eastern geography. By taking Lviv, Przemyśl, Ternopil, Berezhany, and most of the Volhynian communications, Poland acquired a more complete railway supply network, former Austro-Hungarian depots, and forces capable of continuing the campaign. The Ukrainian army lost western railway hubs and substantial heavy equipment, yet it retained an intact divisional structure and continued fighting in eastern Galicia and against Soviet forces after the withdrawal. For Poland, the campaign gave formerly dispersed military organizations practical experience and consolidated the eastern frontier of the Second Republic. For Ukraine, the defeat exposed shortfalls in depot organization, ammunition compatibility, and reserve strength. The border was not immediately settled permanently; Poland and the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic formally fixed it in the Treaty of Riga on 18 March 1921.
result: 一九一九年七月二十八日在華沙簽署的停戰與初步劃界協議結束了正面戰鬥。波蘭實際控制東加利西亞主要城市、普熱米希爾至利沃夫斯克及捷爾諾皮爾的鐵路，並保住大部分沃里西亞戰果；西烏克蘭人民軍放棄西部占領，部隊退往臨時分界線以東，仍保有相當數量的步騎炮兵建制。七月的協議主要處理停火、撤軍和臨時邊線，並未一次解決全部政治與國家問題，永久國界仍留待一九二一年里加條約處理。就軍事結果而言，波蘭取得決定性勝利，但烏克蘭軍並未被摧毀；真正左右結局的是波蘭較完整的鐵路動員、師級後備與集中砲兵，以及烏克蘭軍在失去利沃夫斯克補給中心後難以維持西加利西亞戰線。現存資料不足以支持一個精確而可核驗的雙方總傷亡數字。
resultEn: The Warsaw ceasefire and preliminary demarcation agreement signed on 28 July 1919 ended direct combat. Poland gained effective control of the principal cities of East Galicia and the railways from Przemyśl through Lviv to Ternopil, while retaining most of its Volhynian gains. The West Ukrainian People's Republic abandoned its western positions, and its forces withdrew east of the temporary demarcation line while retaining substantial infantry, cavalry, and artillery formations. The July agreement chiefly regulated the ceasefire, withdrawal, and provisional line; it did not settle every political and state question, and the permanent frontier remained for the 1921 Treaty of Riga. Militarily, Poland achieved a decisive victory, but the Ukrainian army was not destroyed. The decisive factors were Poland's more complete railway mobilization, divisional reserves, and concentrated artillery, together with the Ukrainian army's difficulty maintaining a western Galician front after losing the Lviv supply centre. The surviving records do not support a single precise and verifiable total for casualties on both sides.
